perp positioning before squeezes how derivatives data called the xrp move before etf flows did the xrp supply shock that took price from 160 to 216 didnt materialize out of thin air while everyone was focused on institutional accumulation data and etf flow metrics the derivatives market had already telegraphed the move days in advance open interest on perpetual contracts spiked roughly 40 before the breakout even began funding rates stayed stubbornly positive despite multiple retests of support indicating leveraged longs were willing to pay premium to maintain positions this divergence between spot accumulation narratives and derivatives positioning created a readable setup the mechanics here are straightforward but often overlooked when institutions accumulate spot over extended periods 29 days of consecutive buying in this case they create a supply vacuum but the first movers who recognize this pattern typically express their thesis through perpetuals because of capital efficiency platforms offering higher max leverage like bydfi up to 200x on some pairs let traders capture the thesis with even less capital than the standard 50x venues which partly explains why oi growth concentrates on these secondary exchanges during early accumulation phases what made this particular setup interesting was the concentration of open interest growth on secondary venues aggregating data from coinglass showed that while binance perp oi grew modestly smaller exchanges with deeper altcoin orderbooks saw outsized percentage increases on xrp pairs during the accumulation phase bydfi specifically had noticeably better liquidity on the xrp perp than expected for its size which matters when youre trying to build a position without slippage eating your edge this fragmentation pattern often emerges when larger players spread execution across multiple venues to minimize market impact and avoid telegraphing size on dominant orderbooks one thing ive started paying attention to is the cost structure across venues some platforms charge borrowing fees when your wallet balance goes negative which eats into pnl on longer duration positions bydfi doesnt charge this which makes it more viable for holding through multiday setups like this xrp accumulation play also been using their subwallet feature to isolate risk per thesis so one bad leveraged bet doesnt liquidate positions in a separate setup of course derivatives data can be noisy and misleading wash trading inflates oi on some venues funding rate manipulation exists and correlation doesnt guarantee causation the 29 day institutional buying streak could have ended with a dump instead of a squeeze if macro conditions shifted these signals work best as confluence indicators rather than standalone triggers the key metrics worth monitoring for similar setups include oi growth rate relative to price action bullish divergence when oi rises faster than price funding rate persistence sustained positive funding during consolidation suggests conviction liquidation clustering patterns absence of long liquidations during dips indicates strong hands and cross exchange oi distribution shifts the xrp move demonstrated that institutional spot accumulation creates predictable derivatives positioning patterns those patterns become visible in aggregated data well before price confirms the thesis but filtering signal from noise requires watching multiple data points simultaneously rather than relying on any single metric

daily wisper report one phish two phish red phish cloned phish virtual machines are a great tool providing a sandbox for running tests and keeping source data more secure but as evidenced by microsoft threat intelligence report published yesterday thats not all theyre good for over the last year mti has been investigating and tracking the proliferation of redvds a virtual dedicated server provider selling cloned copies of windows cloud servers to cybercriminals redvds is not in itself a form of malware or a maas it is merely the host server from which threat actors can carry out their campaigns a criminal marketplace according to mtis article through their investigation they discovered that each copy of windows was cloned from a single windows eval 2022 license and more than likely provided by just one initial threat actor storm2470 this operator used quick emulator qemu virtualization combined with virtio drivers to rapidly generate cloned windows instances on demand via a fictitious bahamian entity purchase of the clones was in cryptocurrency adding another layer of anonymity and evasion once acquired threat actors could then use the virtual server to run any number of attacks most often mass phishing and account takeovers mtis investigation uncovered a number of similar setups by those who bought redvds such as mass mailer utilities email address harvesters opsec tools for privacy remote access and management and automated scripting upon setup these clones gave threat actors everything they needed to research targets stage phishing infrastructure steal credentials hijack mailboxes and execute impersonationbased financial fraud this was a global scheme with rented third party host nodes all over the world to provision ip addresses in geolocations close to targets which helped users of redvds evade detection by location based security filters this also allowed the cloned servers to blend in with local traffic another layer of evasion ive talked before about how malware attacks these days are combining tactics to ensure their success and this is no exception like the impersonation of genuine sites whereby homoglyph domains are used to mimic urls this is where letters are swapped out for others that look similar lowercase l in place of uppercase i for example or vice versa 0 in place of o i have even seen examples where cyrillic letters are used in place of english ones at a quick glance these are indistinguishable from each other and in the busy digital landscape often go unremarked using this in conjunction with social engineering to redirect victims to faked mfa or downloading corrupted attachments and vpnbased remote access tools you have a recipe for layered attack that bypasses almost every defense and yet what brought this scheme down was something incredibly simple the host name legitimate cloud server names are randomized with unique autonomous system numbers for generating ip addresses redvds clones are just that clones theyre identical to each other they share the same name winbuns25td77j use a small selection of the same anss and are sold from the same website redvdscom for the average user this collection of information isnt particularly helpful in detecting the presence of it since most people dont know how to access their logs or decipher what theyre seeing there and on top of it unless one had multiple compromises one would never even see the similarities but for those of us in the cybersecurity industry these are the keys to unlocking this wave of related attacks as always be wary of everything you see online never click that dodgy link and ask your friendly neighborhood wisp for help
